ei.title: Why Your Voice Sounds Different to You
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: Have you ever been surprised to hear a recording of your own voice? You might have thought, "Is that really what my voice sounds like?" Maybe your accent is more pronounced in the recording than you realized, or your voice is higher than it seems to your own ears. This is of course quite a common experience. The explanation is actually fairly simple. There are two pathways through which we perceive our own voice when we speak. One is the route through which we perceive most external sounds, like waves that travel from the air through the outer, middle and inner ear. But because our vocal cords vibrate when we speak, there is a second internal path. Vibrations are conducted through our bones and stimulate our inner ears directly. Lower frequencies are emphasized along this pathway. That makes your voice sound deeper and richer to yourself than it may sound to other people.

questions.passage: Have you ever been (A)[surprised / bored] to hear a recording of your own voice? You might have thought, "Is that really what my voice sounds like?" Maybe your accent is more (B)[pronounced / hidden] in the recording than you realized, or your voice is higher than it seems to your own ears. This is of course quite a common experience. One is the route through which we perceive most external sounds, like waves that travel from the air through the outer, middle and inner ear. But because our vocal cords vibrate when we speak, there is a second (C)[temporary / internal] path. Vibrations are conducted through our bones and stimulate our inner ears directly. Lower frequencies are emphasized along this pathway. That makes your voice sound deeper and richer to yourself than it may sound to other people.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① surprised — pronounced — internal: 원문 일치. 자기 목소리 녹음에 놀라고(surprised), 억양이 더 뚜렷하며(pronounced), 두 번째 내부(internal) 경로가 있다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② bored: '지루한'은 놀란다는 맥락과 다름
❌ ③ hidden: '숨겨진'은 억양이 더 뚜렷하다는 맥락과 반대
❌ ④ temporary: '일시적인'은 내부 경로라는 맥락과 무관

det.korean: 수동태 be + 과거분사: Vibrations are conducted (진동이 전도되다)
det.analysis: 'Vibrations are __________ (conduct) through our bones'에서 진동이 뼈를 통해 '전도되는' 수동 관계이므로 수동태(be + 과거분사)가 필요하다. conduct의 과거분사는 conducted. conduct → conducted.
det.tip: 수동태 be + 과거분사. are conducted = 전도되다

questions.passage: Maybe your accent is more pronounced in the recording than you __________ (realize). This is of course quite a common experience. The explanation is actually fairly simple. There are two pathways through which we perceive our own voice when we speak.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 과거 시제: 비교 대상이 과거에 인식한 정도이므로 과거형
det.analysis: 'than you __________ (realize)'에서 녹음 속 억양을 과거에 '인식했던' 정도와 비교하므로 과거형이 자연스럽다. realize의 과거형은 realized. realize → realized.
det.tip: than + 주어 + 과거동사(비교절). than you realized = 당신이 인식했던 것보다

questions.passage: Have you ever been surprised to hear a recording of your own voice? You might have thought, "Is that really what my voice sounds like?" Maybe your accent is more pronounced in the recording than you realized, or your voice is higher than it seems to your own ears. This is of course quite a common experience. The explanation is actually fairly simple. There are two pathways through which we perceive our own voice when we speak. One is __________, like waves that travel from the air through the outer, middle and inner ear. But because our vocal cords vibrate when we speak, there is a second internal path. Vibrations are conducted through our bones and stimulate our inner ears directly. Lower frequencies are emphasized along this pathway. That makes your voice sound deeper and richer to yourself than it may sound to other people.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: the route through which we perceive most external sounds=대부분의 외부 소리를 인지하는 경로 — 두 경로 중 하나
det.analysis:
✅ ① the route through which we perceive most external sounds: 원문 일치. 하나는 공기를 통해 전달되는 외부 소리를 인지하는 경로이다 ←정답
❌ ② a path that blocks all outside noise(외부 소음을 차단하는 길): 본문 근거 없음
❌ ③ a signal sent directly by the brain(뇌가 보내는 신호): 본문 근거 없음
❌ ④ a frequency produced only by machines(기계가 만드는 주파수): 본문 근거 없음
det.tip: One is the route through which we perceive most external sounds

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: makes your voice sound deeper and richer to yourself=당신 자신에게 목소리가 더 깊고 풍부하게 들리게 한다 — 뼈 전도 경로의 효과
det.analysis:
❌ ① removes your accent from the recording(녹음에서 억양을 없앤다): 본문 근거 없음
❌ ② blocks the sound from reaching your ears(소리가 귀에 닿는 것을 막는다): 본문과 반대
✅ ③ makes your voice sound deeper and richer to yourself: 원문 일치. 낮은 주파수 강조가 자신에게 목소리를 더 깊고 풍부하게 들리게 한다 ←정답
❌ ④ sends vibrations away from your bones(진동을 뼈에서 멀리 보낸다): 진동이 뼈를 통해 전도된다는 설명과 반대
det.tip: That makes your voice sound deeper and richer to yourself
